status: candidates listed for the smoke check and the casting screen; none heard; nothing selected
howToFill: 1. Pin the exact engine/model above for the whole pass; a different version is a different candidate label.

2. For each role list up to three candidates (labels C01, C02, C03): {label, voice: <shape below>, rights: {status, terms, credit}, pickedBecause}. Candidates come from the pool; say why each was picked (e.g. from the provider’s description) and that it was not yet heard.
3. rights.status must start with "ok" (e.g. "ok_private_audition") only after the voice’s terms were read for synthetic acting of an original character; otherwise its cells stay blocked_rights.

4. The smoke check uses the narrator’s first candidate; the casting screen renders every candidate on the role’s two anchor lines; `selected` is set only after listening (Robin’s or a recorded listener’s), and discarded candidates move to `discarded` with a short reason.

candidatesNote: Picked from the one-word descriptions Google gives its 30 prebuilt voices (speech-generation documentation, as returned by search on 2026-10-13), to match each role’s casting target; not heard by anyone. Google’s pages tag voices by gender inconsistently, so no presentation is assumed: the screen is where they are heard. Voices recur across NPC roles (allowed on the screen, disclosed); the main roles’ lists do not share a voice. Rights: the prebuilt voices are Google’s; their use is governed by the Gemini API terms, recorded in the authorization (covered_by_authorization) once read.
